provenance: Original content — The Alchemist's Ledger, © 2026 Example Campaign
attribution: Written for this repository as content-pack test material.
note: Thirty-eight items and the six conditions they impose, and nothing else. This is the pack shape the bundled slice cannot provide — the SRD data ships no items at all, so a session that wants potions and flasks gets them from a file like this one. 'Inert Draught' deliberately does nothing but apply a condition with no flags: a dud, and the ledger records duds.

items.name: Ledger Restorative, Lesser
items.description: The house standard. Two coppers, tastes of iron.

items.name: Ledger Restorative, Greater
items.description: Four times the price and rather more than four times the effect.

items.name: Ledger Restorative, Superior
items.description: Kept behind the counter. Sold to people the house trusts.

items.name: Field Stitching Salve
items.description: Closes an open wound without a needle. Scars badly.

items.name: Bonesetter's Cordial
items.description: For the sort of injury that makes a noise.

items.name: Sailmender's Tincture
items.description: Meant for canvas. Works on skin, unpleasantly.

items.name: Waking Salts
items.description: Held under the nose of somebody who has stopped arguing.
unmodelled: Ends an ordinary faint outright, which the engine does not model

items.name: Ledger Blood Restorer
items.description: For blood loss specifically. The house is proud of it.

items.name: Ledger Firebottle
items.description: Naphtha and a wick. The house sells more of these than anything else.

items.name: Ledger Firebottle, Heavy
items.description: Twice the naphtha and a shorter wick. Sold with a warning.

items.name: Vitriol Flask
items.description: Strong acid in thin glass. No wick, no warning.

items.name: Fuming Vitriol
items.description: The same acid, left open until it started to smoke.

items.name: Frost Ampoule
items.description: Something in it is much colder than it should be.

items.name: Thundershot Cylinder
items.description: A sealed tube that makes a noise felt in the chest.

items.name: Static Jar
items.description: Charged foil in glass. Opening it is the whole use.

items.name: Ledger Blightpowder
items.description: Ground fungus. Breathed in, it does real harm.

items.name: Grave-Wick Vial
items.description: Bought from somewhere the house does not name in the ledger.

items.name: Consecrated Oil Flask
items.description: Blessed, then bottled, then priced accordingly.

items.name: Mindsplinter Phial
items.description: Very expensive, and the house will not explain it.

items.name: Kinetic Charge
items.description: Force in a canister. No heat, no light, considerable effect.

items.name: Caltrop Sachet
items.description: A paper twist of iron points. Cheap and effective.

items.name: Weighted Shot Bag
items.description: Lead shot in canvas. Not alchemy, and the house sells it anyway.

items.name: Razorleaf Packet
items.description: Dried leaf with an edge like a blade, scattered hard.

items.name: Ledger Tar Pot
items.description: Hot tar. It holds boots to floors and hands to weapons.

items.name: Numbing Draught
items.description: Sold as a painkiller. Sold rather more often as a weapon.

items.name: Blister Balm
items.description: Applied to someone else's skin, against their preference.

items.name: Smokestick
items.description: Burns dirty on purpose. Two coppers, and worth ten.

items.name: Quickblood Shot
items.description: The house's most-regretted product. It works, briefly.
unmodelled: An hour later the user cannot stand; that is outside a fight's scope

items.name: Inert Draught
items.description: A batch that failed. The house sells it cheap and says so.
unmodelled: It genuinely does nothing. Recorded because the ledger records failures

items.name: Battle Draught
items.description: Heals and quickens. The house charges for both.

items.name: Surgeon's Reserve
items.description: The last vial in the bag, by convention.

items.name: Ledger Antivenin
items.description: For the house's own poisons, chiefly.
unmodelled: Ends an ordinary poisoning outright, which is what it is bought for

items.name: Char-Salve
items.description: For burns. The house sells a great many firebottles.

items.name: Ledger Etching Acid
items.description: Sold for glass. Bought for other reasons.

items.name: Slow-Match Bundle
items.description: Burns for an hour and will light anything at the end of it.

items.name: Ledger Sleeping Powder
items.description: Not a sedative in any legal sense. It numbs.

items.name: Brightflare Cartridge
items.description: Signals a mile off, or blinds someone standing close.

items.name: House Reserve Elixir
items.description: One bottle, not for sale, kept for whoever runs the shop.
unmodelled: There is exactly one, and the ledger notes who last drank it

conditions.name: ledger-blistered
conditions.description: Chemical burns across the hands. Grip is the first thing to go.

conditions.name: ledger-numbed
conditions.description: The creature cannot feel its own limbs well enough to place them.

conditions.name: ledger-fume-blind
conditions.description: Smoke or flare-glare. Either way, nothing is where it looks.

conditions.name: ledger-tar-stuck
conditions.description: Stuck fast to the floor, or to whatever was underfoot.

conditions.name: ledger-quickened
conditions.description: Everything is very fast and very clear and will not last.

conditions.name: ledger-inert
conditions.description: Nothing happened. The creature is briefly aware that nothing happened.
unmodelled: No flags at all, on purpose: a dud is still worth recording
